progression.narrative: The performance opens on G4 and dwells most on G in Majles Afruz. The line peaks at Bb4 (467.8 Hz) at 0:15.8. It closes on the tonic (Ak4 → Ak4 → Ak4 → Ak4 → Ak4 → G4).
